task_spec: AnsiDecoder.decode must preserve the newline structure of the input, including blank/trailing lines -- decoding text with trailing or repeated newlines must not collapse or drop them. (Textualize/rich#4076)

bugs.description:
decode iterates terminal_text.splitlines(), which discards information about trailing and consecutive newlines (e.g. 'a

b' and 'a
b' become indistinguishable, and a trailing '
' is dropped). Decoding no longer preserves the input's blank/trailing lines. The fix splits on newline boundaries with re.split(r'(?<=
)') instead.
bugs.seed_note: NATURAL post-cutoff bug: inverse of Textualize/rich PR #4076.
